entities.summary: Robert de Lenoncourt was a French bishop, archbishop, cardinal, and diplomat. He was the son of Thierry de Lenoncourt, Seigneur de Vignory, Councillor and Chamberlain of the King, and Jeanne de Ville. He had a brother, Henry, Sire de Lenoncourt and Baron of Vignory, a sister, Jacquette, who married Jean d'Aguerre, son of the Governor of Mouzon, another sister, Nicole, who married Érard du Châtelet. Robert's paternal uncle, also called Robert de Lenoncourt, was Archbishop of Reims.
